terms_note: Gutendex is the read-only metadata API; texts are fetched from the item's own formats map.
notes: Gutendex reports copyright as a boolean. Probed 2026-09-03 over 20 items: present on 100%, eligible on 100%, only value observed was false. null means Gutenberg has not determined status and is not a clearance.

terms_note: Advanced search API for identifiers, then the per-item metadata endpoint; identify the client and stay within the documented rate.
notes: The first draft named metadata.rights, which the probe found on no item at all; the field carrying a determination is possible-copyright-status, set on items a librarian reviewed and absent elsewhere. Presence follows the query, not the repository: probed 2026-09-03, a loose title search returned 8% presence while 'collection:cdl AND mediatype:texts AND date:[1800-01-01 TO 1860-12-31]' returned 100% over 20 items, every observed value NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT. Discovery should scope to scanning-partner collections and a period. Absence is status unknown and therefore ineligible, never a default to public domain.
